source: Four user-supplied PA-04 chart/table screenshots, attached to the request on 2026-10-27. Manual transcription; manufacturer revision/date and original URL not supplied.

conditions.direction: opposing load magnitude; directional distinction not supplied

digitization: Current endpoints 4 and 14 A; speed endpoints approximately 0.47 and 0.39 inch/s, read from the supplied graph. No precision beyond graph resolution is claimed.

geometry.allowance_source: user, adjustable; added to each endpoint once; no allowance mass supplied

mass_fit.method: Affine ordinary least squares, 13 catalog rows; 9, 18, 30 inch rows withheld before fitting

validity.outside_domain: Strict helper rejection; finite component diagnostics are flagged with negative feasibility margins and curve_valid=0 where appropriate

calibration: Catalog approximation only. Withheld catalog rows are not independent physical experiments. No independent hardware validation, lowering/regeneration, thermal or duty-cycle data supplied.
assumptions: Rated-load lowering at 0.39 inch/s and 14 A
Raising uses maximum sampled loaded extraction force, including breakout, over the entire stroke
No regeneration; no additional actuator idle loss or efficiency applied to chart electrical power
Installation brackets/extension allowance mass and detailed mass distribution not provided
